title: Photograph: the blessed letter to Khosrow Parviz, Shahanshah of Persia
headingUrdu: تصویر: نامۂ مبارک بنام کسریٰ پرویز، شہنشاہِ فارس
headingPashto: انځور: د فارس شاهنشاه کسری پرویز په نوم مبارک لیک

paras.en: Photograph of the blessed letter addressed to Khosrow Parviz, Emperor of Persia.
paras.ur: عکسِ نامۂ مبارک بنام کسریٰ پرویز، شہنشاہِ فارس
paras.ps: د فارس د شاهنشاه کسری پرویز په نوم د مبارک لیک انځور.

sourceNote: Printed page 73: a photograph of the torn letter of the Prophet to Khosrow Parviz with a round seal at the bottom right; the photograph is not reproduced; only the printed caption “عکسِ نامۂ مبارک بنام کسریٰ پرویز، شہنشاہِ فارس” is given. The right part of the scan shows the edge of the next page (a black border) and is excluded. English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark, handwriting, page-edge shadows, a thumb at the page edge and ornamental borders excluded. Scan n = printed page n+1 (file = {p//2:03d}_page_2 for even printed page p, {(p-1)//2:03d}_page_1 for odd p).
